description: CLI storm in the light session (cli-storm-session.py running bench_cli_storm.py): 32 control-socket clients send 2000 mixed reads, creates, sends, renames and closes while a terminal streams 50 MB; answered-request latency by category, error replies, the window's frame intervals and main-thread busy per frame, main-thread stalls over 50 ms, unanswered requests, leaked PTY holders, footprint after cleanup against the warm baseline and throughput.
